profile.headline: Sr. WPF Software Developer
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 20+ years of experience architecting, developing, and maintaining scalable backend systems and document automation solutions. Proficient in C#, .NET, Java, AWS, Azure, and DevOps practices. Proven ability to lead development teams, optimize build pipelines, and deliver impactful features. Strong track record of innovation in both startup and enterprise environments.

positions.title: Sr. WPF Software Developer
positions.description:
- Responsible for ongoing support and maintenance of the iPay accounting system.
- Maintain .Net backend web service APIs
positions.insights: Skills: Clean Architecture · ASP.NET Web API · C# · SQL · .NET · Model-view-viewmodel (MVVM) · Git · WPF · Cursor AI · Oracle Database

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Backend development for OCR-based financial statement ingestion.
- Engineered payroll and reporting systems for scalable, real-time data delivery.
- Supported critical accounting workflows (AP, AR, GL) through clean maintainable code.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built and maintained features in core accounting modules.
- Streamlined data flow and improved system performance through refactoring and optimization.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Optimized CI/CD pipelines for the DeltaV automation platform.
- Integrated Fortify SAST to enhance security via automated code scanning.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer Team Lead
positions.description:
- Led development of Xodo, a modern UWP PDF reader with millions of users.
- Designed and implemented premium features and monetization strategies.
- Modernized UI using WinUI for enhanced UX.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · .NET · Git · Universal Windows Platform (UWP)

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer Team Lead
positions.description:
- Architected and led development of all server-based PDF automation products.
- Mentored junior developers and guided architectural decisions.

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description:
- Contributed to the PDF Processing Platform (P3) used across server-based products.
- Implemented features, bug fixes, and customer support enhancements.

positions.title: Information Analyst
positions.description:
- Maintained and developed document management systems including ProjectWise and Documentum.
- Developed internal tools to diagnose server failures and improve system reliability.
- Supported enterprise document workflows for major clients (e.g., Towers Watson).
positions.insights: Skills: Documentum · Web Development · Enterprise Content Management · Java · C++ · C# · SQL · Microsoft SQL Server · Knowledge Management · .NET · Oracle Database · JavaScript

positions.title: Senior IT Specialist
positions.description:
- Developed web and desktop components for company-wide document management.
- Maintained intranet portals and legacy systems using VB and ASP.
positions.insights: Skills: Documentum · Web Development · Enterprise Content Management · Java · C++ · C# · SQL · Microsoft SQL Server · Knowledge Management · .NET · Oracle Database · JavaScript
